identity_note: Matched Carr, Riggs & Ingram (CRI), the Enterprise, AL-based top-25 US CPA and advisory firm at criadv.com. Sector, website and the Centerbridge/Bessemer backing all match the batch entry; no meaningful name collision.

profile.name: Carr, Riggs & Ingram (CRI)
profile.description: Top-25 US CPA and advisory firm offering audit, tax, client accounting, transaction advisory, CFO and wealth/trust services to middle-market businesses, nonprofits, healthcare and government clients.
profile.location: Enterprise, AL (HQ); 50+ markets across ~15 states plus Chihuahua and Juárez, Mexico
profile.founder: Bill Carr (founding partner, now Chairman); Dee Burger is CEO (CRI's first CEO, named June 25, 2026; ex-President North America, Insight Enterprises)
profile.funding_detail: Strategic growth investment from Centerbridge Partners (lead) with Bessemer Venture Partners, announced Nov 2024; terms undisclosed. Accounting Today 2026 Top 100: No. 23, $601M revenue.
profile.headcount: Over 2,700 employees, 483 partners, 41 offices (Accounting Today, June 2026); CRI's own site says 2,000+ professionals
profile.past_completed_deals: 12+ acquisitions since the Nov 2024 investment: CapinCrouse (Jan 2025, Indianapolis), Axley & Rode (Jun 2025, Lufkin TX), Williams Steinert Mask (Sep 2025, San Antonio), Abroms & Associates (Oct 2025, Florence AL), DK Partners (Dec 2025, Austin), Cayton & Associates (Jan 2026, Greenville NC), CFO Hub (Mar 2026, San Diego), Crowl, Cameron & Associates (Jun 2026, Conroe TX), DMR CPAs (Aug 2026, Fort Worth; called the 12th since the investment), Trace Advisory (Aug 2026, Ridgeland MS; now CRI Government Solutions), Morrison & Smith (Sep 2026, Tuscaloosa AL).
profile.open_role: No corp-dev roles; hiring Tax, Audit, CapinCrouse, Campus Recruits, Preferred Legacy Trust, CFO Hub, Capital Markets (146 open roles) as of 2026-10-08

verdict.headline: Active acquirer · 6 deals in 2026 · no corp dev seat open
verdict.detail: PE-backed (Centerbridge/Bessemer) CPA roll-up closing a deal roughly every 1-2 months; Chairman Bill Carr fronts every deal and new CEO Dee Burger owns the growth mandate.

caveats: Deal count: CRI's own releases number the deals inconsistently (Crowl Cameron called 7th, 8th or 10th; DMR called 12th); list above is from dated releases.
Headcount: Accounting Today says 2,700+ employees (June 2026); CRI's site still says 2,000+.
Corp dev: no named corp-dev or M&A head found on CRI's site or in releases; CRI M&A Advisors is a sell-side advisory affiliate, not CRI's buy-side team.
LinkedIn: no personal LinkedIn verified for Bill Carr or Dee Burger; left null.
Funding: Centerbridge/Bessemer deal terms and stake size are undisclosed.
Careers read: 146 roles read from the embedded Paycor job board behind criadv.com/career-opportunities/; 'Corporate' dept has a Business Development Executive and payroll role, not corp dev.
